name: Claims Intake Agent
description: Reads an incoming claim submission, extracts key fields, classifies claim type, and routes it to the right downstream queue.

name: Fraud Detection Agent
description: Screens transactions or claims against anomaly-detection rules and flags high-risk items for human review.

name: IT Helpdesk Agent
description: Resolves common employee IT requests (password resets, access requests) automatically and escalates anything unfamiliar to a human technician.

name: Contract Review Agent
description: Reads an incoming contract, compares clauses against an approved playbook, and produces a redline summary for legal review.
